name: Vercel Skills
description: Installs, updates, and searches agent skills from GitHub, GitLab, any git URL, or a local path into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other coding agents via npx skills.

skills.name: Skill Installation
skills.description: Installs skills from GitHub shorthand, any git URL, or a local path into one or more agents, at project or global scope, by symlink or copy.

skills.name: One-Off Skill Use
skills.description: Generates a prompt from a skill without installing it, or starts a supported coding agent with that skill loaded, using skills use.

skills.name: Skill Search
skills.description: Searches for skills interactively or by keyword, optionally across every repository owned by one organization or user, with skills find.

skills.name: Skill Updates And Removal
skills.description: Lists, updates, and removes installed skills per agent and scope, and scaffolds a new SKILL.md template with skills init.
